If you'd like to reproduce this my code is all in github as a maven project here: https://github.com/aaronriekenberg/Simple-Message-Service

Steps:
1. Run https://github.com/aaronriekenberg/Simple-Message-Service/blob/master/sms-broker/src/main/java/org/aaron/sms/broker/SMSBrokerMain.java (server)
2. Run https://github.com/aaronriekenberg/Simple-Message-Service/blob/master/sms-examples/src/main/java/org/aaron/sms/examples/SMSTestReceiver.java (50 clients receiving messages)
3. Run https://github.com/aaronriekenberg/Simple-Message-Service/blob/master/sms-examples/src/main/java/org/aaron/sms/examples/SMSTestSender.java (50 clients sending messages)
4. Kill SMSTestReceiver and look for the exception in SMSBrokerMain.  The exception happens about 50% of the time when SMSTestReceiver is killed.

This project and test programs worked with Netty 3.6.6.

Thank you!

@mrniko is there some easy way for me to reproduce ?

Of course, it's a netty-socketio project. Steps:
1. build https://github.com/mrniko/netty-socketio/tree/netty-4.x.x
2. build https://github.com/mrniko/netty-socketio-demo/tree/netty-4.x.x
3. cd to netty-socketio-demo/server dir and run netty-socketio server by command:
   mvn exec:java -Dmain.class=com.corundumstudio.socketio.demo.TestBug -Dorg.slf4j.simpleLogger.defaultLogLevel=debug
4. open follow page in firefox or opera (not chrome): 
   ...\netty-socketio-demo\client\index.html
5. click 'send' button, when just hold 'enter' in push state (this leads to many messages from client to server )
6. after 10-20 or lower you will get an error in console.

Could you show me the diff?

Am 27.07.2013 um 18:42 schrieb Nikita Koksharov notifications@github.com:

> I fixed it. Problem was in HttpObjectAggregator. Object this.currentMessage been never released.
> 
> Just comment out 180 line in HttpObjectAggregator:
> this.currentMessage = null;
> 
> Because currentMessage releases now in "HttpObjectAggregator.channelInactive" method:
> 
> currentMessage.release();
> 
> So, all works fine now!
> 
> —

Your fix is incorrect. The next handler in the pipeline most likely did not release the message probably and that is the problem.

@mrniko you miss to release the HttpRequest after you handled it here: https://github.com/mrniko/netty-socketio/blob/netty-4.x.x/src/main/java/com/corundumstudio/socketio/handler/AuthorizeHandler.java#L80. 

Use ReferenceCountUtil.release(...)
